narr: More heavy rain occurred due to plenty of moisture and lift around the Blue Ridge Mountains of central Virginia. The ground was already saturated due to previous rainfall, so this led to more instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: Walkers Mountain Road was washed out due to water flowing over the road from Brown Creek.
The intersection of Cold Storage Lane and Arrington Road was washed out due to flowing water.
The intersection of of Craigtown Road and Naked Mountain Road was washed out due to flowing water.
Mill Pond Road was closed due to high flowing water from Cove Creek being out of its banks.
Several areas of high water were flowing over Stephens Loop and Progress place, causing the 12400 block of Spotswood Trail to be impassable.
